name: resistance band standing balance glute kickback
description: A standing band kickback that builds the glutes while challenging your balance on one leg.
instructions: Loop the band around your ankles or hold it under your standing foot.
Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee and brace your abs.
Kick the other leg straight back against the band.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your lower back.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
